monitor_metadata.limitations: Sampled intervals may miss short-lived processes; inaccessible/new processes have unknown CPU deltas; GPU engine values are not additive.

summary.aggregation: Rates are medians of four process means per arm per cell. Paired changes are geometric means of the two round ratios, each ratio using geometric means of that round: two candidate and two main process means. All samples retained.
interpretation_limits: Each process reports a mean and SD over five timed iterations; per-iteration raw timings are not exposed.
System disk activity includes this benchmark model loading. A disk flag is not proof of unrelated work.
Sampled process counters can miss short-lived processes and leave inaccessible or newly seen processes unknown.
GPU engine maxima are not additive; benchmark and monitor PIDs are separated from unrelated activity.
One same-file layout perturbation does not bound all code layout effects.
This compares with main; reference-runtime floors, MI50 and new 8B correctness are separate gates.
summary.activity_interpretation: 142 of 144 calls have at least one predeclared activity flag, retained without filtering. GPU activity from other processes is present in 117 calls; process CPU flags include game, browser, editor and agent processes, whose task ownership is not inferred from their names. All calls have inaccessible or new-process CPU deltas. Unknown counter items and six query errors affect GPU engine instances; CPU and disk counters have no unknown items or errors. Per-process calls span loading, warmup and both measured phases, so activity is conservative over that whole interval and not attributed to an individual timed iteration.
summary.verdict: Measured decode cost on Radeon is 2.116 to 4.444 percent, repeated in both rounds of every GPU cell, while the same-file control decode changes are -0.193 to +0.205 percent. GPU prefill changes are -0.309 to +0.021 percent. This motivates cost investigation and review, not an automatic rejection or a claim that all remaining gates passed. CPU figures are guardrails with activity and layout variation, not a new optimization claim.
